original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：万杜济桥发生武装抢劫，一名男子被枪杀，约50万梅蒂卡尔被抢
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据莫桑比克警方通报，一伙仍在逃的犯罪分子在马尼卡省6号国道万杜济河大桥上实施武装抢劫，开枪打死一名年轻男子，抢走约50万梅蒂卡尔，并用金属钉刺带（当地称“lagarta”）封锁道路。警方称，四名劫匪持枪拦截了一辆本田Fit轿车，车上人员反抗时遭枪击。目前尚无人员被正式拘留，案件仍在调查中。

location.raw_text: bridge over the Vanduzi River, along National Road No. 6, in Manica Province

key_facts.fact: 一伙仍在逃的犯罪分子在马尼卡省6号国道万杜济河大桥实施武装抢劫
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A group of criminals who remain at large carried out an armed robbery last night on the bridge over the Vanduzi River, along National Road No. 6, in Manica Province.

key_facts.fact: 劫匪开枪打死一名年轻男子，抢走约50万梅蒂卡尔
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They shot and killed a young man, stole around 500,000 meticais

key_facts.fact: 劫匪用金属钉刺带封锁道路，导致其他车辆轮胎被扎破
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: blocked the road with a tire deflation device (TDD), a metal-spiked strip as a “lagarta”

key_facts.fact: 警方称四名持枪劫匪拦截了一辆本田Fit轿车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the victim and three other people were travelling in a Honda Fit in the direction of Chimoio–Manica when they were intercepted by four robbers travelling in a Toyota Axio and armed with a firearm whose type has not yet been identified

key_facts.fact: 目前尚无人员因该案被正式拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: So far, no one has been formally detained in connection with the case.

uncertainties: 劫匪所持枪支类型尚未确认
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
尚无人员被正式拘留，案件仍在调查中
